title: Parish Plant Manager
text:
Good Shepherd Catholic Church

Elk Grove

Employment Type

Full Time

Wage

Exempt $72,384 per year

The Parish Plant Manager role is responsible for care, maintenance, and operational readiness of parish facilities and grounds while coordinating the practical needs of parish activities. This position ensures the success of future ministry and facilities growth by assessing and implementing varied support to accomplish practical needs and sustainable growth of the Parish as a whole (School and Church).

Responsibilities include maintenance planning and implementation, improvement projects, vendor coordination, technical support, and event logistics. Working with the Business Manager, Pastor, staff, and ministry leaders, the manager establishes priorities, coordinates resources, and follows work through to completion to support worship, ministries, and parish life.
